feedback: Judged before racing. The candidate is valid and reverts sensor_size from 0.016 to 0.012, the iteration 5 geometry, which is still the best raced design at 84.33. It also raises kd from 0.25 to 0.30 with kp 4.0, ki 0.3 and base_speed 1.3 unchanged. Iteration 6 (sensor_size 0.016) scored 82.98, below iteration 5, and its oval steering_oscillation of 0.256 exceeded the 0.25 return threshold, so reverting the footprint is supported. The kd step is the uncertain part. Between iterations 3 and 4 (kp 4.0 at y 0.04), raising kd from 0.20 to 0.25 moved oval oscillation from 0.208 to 0.254, so more damping may not reduce jitter here, and the noisy-derivative risk is real. max_error has stayed at 0.061 to 0.065 m in every iteration 0 to 6 whatever kp, ki, kd, base_speed, sensor y or sensor_size were, so this change is unlikely to remove the off-track floor by itself. The candidate is still a clean single-direction test against the best raced design, and racing it is more informative than another read. Do not treat the expected score or oscillation as established; neither has been measured for it. After the race, decide from the telemetry. If the score is at or above 84.33 and oval steering_oscillation is under about 0.25, keep kd 0.30 as the new base. If oscillation rises above 0.25 or the score falls below 84.33, return kd to 0.25 (iteration 5). If max_error still sits at 0.061 to 0.065 m, the gain and footprint levers have failed, so the next test is the sensor x spread rather than more kd or kp. Do not raise base_speed until progress nears 0.995 with no line loss. Completion within 3 s is not expected at base_speed 1.3.
requested_changes: If the race scores below 84.33 (iteration 5) or oval steering_oscillation exceeds 0.25, set controller.kd back to 0.25 with geometry.sensor_size 0.012, which is the iteration 5 design. Iteration 4 showed kd 0.25 at y 0.04 raising oscillation to 0.254, so the kd step must be judged against the measured oscillation.

If max_error stays at 0.061 to 0.065 m with line_loss_events of 1 or more after this race, test a narrower or wider sensor x spread (for example x -0.03 to 0.03 at y 0.06, sensor_size 0.012) instead of further kd or kp changes, because gain changes across iterations 2 to 4 and the footprint change in iteration 6 did not move max_error.
Do not raise controller.base_speed above 1.3 until progress nears 0.995 with no line loss. Iterations 0 to 6 all went off track, and speed only matters once the robot stays on the line.
